title: JEWELRY STORE SAFE CODE
yt_title: Jewelry Store Safe Code 9357 in GTA 6 (Don't Blow It)
hook: Here's the jewelry store safe code in GTA 6: 9357, and where the game hides it.
tips: 1. Jewelry store safe code is on the wall by the counter: 9357 (TG cyAPzaLcEsM 2174-2198; 'Safe code: 9357' HUD on frame)

2. Game hint: a safe code is sometimes kept at the location or known by staff (on-frame tooltip 2132; Mr Lawrence FGT8wNrw6Pw 0:58 'find the code or use explosives'; Zancudo qRbrGtiLKxU 4:54 code in employee desk)
3. Explosives are the alternative (Plant explosive prompt on frame 2150-2186)

parts.text: Here's the jewelry store safe code in GTA 6. It's nine three five seven, and the game hides it in plain sight.
parts.label: Safe code 9357
parts.proof: 'Safe code: 9357' HUD at the wall 2182, keypad + Notes 9357 2189

parts.text: One. Walk into the jewelry store in the mall and point a weapon at the staff. That starts the robbery.
parts.label: 1  Rob the store
parts.proof: aiming at staff 2090-2102 (TG 2064 'I'm about to rob this place')

parts.text: Two. Head through the back room. The safe is in the workshop, and it asks you for a code.
parts.label: 2  Back room safe
parts.proof: back door 2108, workshop 2114-2126, ENTER CODE prompt 2150-2162 (TG 2137 'where's the code at?')

parts.text: Three. You can plant explosives, but don't. The game tells you a safe code is sometimes kept at the location, or known by staff.
parts.label: 3  Find the code
parts.proof: tooltip 'A safe code is sometimes kept at the location or known by staff' 2132; keypad 2156; Plant explosive prompt 2150

parts.text: Four. Look around the front counter. The code is on the wall: nine three five seven. The game saves it in your notes.
parts.label: 4  Code 9357
parts.proof: 'Safe code: 9357' HUD 2182-2186 (TG 2174 'you see that on the wall? 9357'); Notes 9357 in corner 2188+

parts.text: Five. Go back and punch nine three five seven into the keypad. Then take what's inside.
parts.label: 5  Enter 9357
parts.proof: walk back 2184; keypad entry 2189-2196 with Notes 9357 (TG 2187 'put it all in'); workshop after 2199

parts.text: Safe code nine three five seven. Did it work for you? Drop a comment and tell me how much you got.

desc_steps: 1. Walk into the jewelry store in the mall (Legendary Custom Jewelry) and point a weapon at the staff to start the robbery.
2. Go through the back room to the workshop. The safe there asks for a code.
3. You can plant explosives, but the game also tells you a safe code is sometimes kept at the location or known by staff.
4. Look around the front counter. The code is on the wall: 9357. The game saves it in your notes.
5. Go back, enter 9357 on the safe keypad, take what's inside, then get out before the police arrive.
verify: Tip: jewelry-store safe code 9357 on the wall by the counter. Transcript: Typical Gamer cyAPzaLcEsM 2174 ('you see that on the wall? 9357'). Frame: 'Safe code: 9357' HUD at 2182-2186, 'Notes 9357' at the keypad 2188-2198, in-game hint at 2132. Single streamer source, but the number and hint are both on screen; Mr Lawrence/Zancudo guides confirm the 'find the code or explode it' mechanic.
